title: Wastewater Concentration and Viral Pathogen Recovery Protocol
author: Shannon Fitz
materials: Select the MagMAX_Wastewater_DUO96 program on the KingFisher DUO

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare all necessary reagents before starting the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 80% ethanol by diluting 100% (absolute) ethanol with nuclease-free water (minimum 2 mL per sample).
Prepare the Binding Bead Mix on the day of use by combining required components for the total number of samples plus 10% excess.
Vortex Binding Beads vigorously to ensure complete resuspension, mix the final Binding Bead Mix well by inversion, and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Initial Sample Processing
steps.instruction: Process the wastewater sample inside a class II/A2 biological safety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Mix 40 mL wastewater sample thoroughly by inverting several times and let settle for 45 seconds at room temperature.
Add 114.3 μL of Nanotrap Enhancement Reagent 3 (ER3), close, and invert twice to mix.
Place sample tubes on a 2 mL magnetic rack for 2 minutes to pellet Nanotrap Particles.

steps.title: Viral Pathogen Capture
steps.instruction: Capture viral pathogens using Nanotrap A Particles.

substeps.instruction: Place samples on a 50 mL magnetic rack for 10 minutes to pellet the Nanotrap particles.
Remove and discard supernatant with a stripette (use a smaller pipette for residual supernatant), avoiding the pellet.
Add 600 μL of Nanotrap Microbiome A Particles, close, and invert twice to mix.

Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes, inverting every few minutes (or use a rotator/horizontal shaker). If using a shaker, secure lids tightly and seal tubes with parafilm and use tape to secure samples.
During incubation, set the heating block to 56°C.

steps.title: Lysis and Particle Recovery
steps.instruction: Lyse the captured pathogens and recover the particles.

substeps.instruction: Place sample tubes on a 2 mL magnetic rack for 2 minutes. If necessary, centrifuge at 2000g for 2-5 seconds to remove drops from the lid before placing on the magnet.
Close tubes and incubate for 10 minutes on the heating block at 56°C.
Remove and discard supernatant with a P-1000 pipette (or smaller pipette for residuals), avoiding the pellet.
Add 500 μL of MagMAX Wastewater Lysis Solution to the pelleted particles and resuspend thoroughly with the pipette.
Carefully remove and discard supernatant using a P-1000 pipette (or smaller pipette for residuals), avoiding the pellet.
Resuspend pelleted Nanotrap particles in 1 mL of Nanotrap Buffer 2, ensuring all particles are collected, and transfer to a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Select Extraction Method
steps.instruction: Choose between automated or manual extraction based on sample volume and equipment.

substeps.instruction: For automated extraction (KingFisher Duo): Transfer 500 μL of lysate to row A of a 96-deep-well sample plate.
For manual extraction: Transfer approximately 500 μL of lysate to a fresh 1.5-2 mL tube and discard pelleted beads.

steps.title: Automated Extraction (KingFisher Duo)
steps.instruction: Perform nucleic acid extraction using the KingFisher Duo Prime instrument.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL of Proteinase K to each sample well in row A.
Invert Binding Bead Mix to resuspend, then add 520 µL to each sample in row A (use fresh tips for each addition; pipette slowly).
Place a 12-tip comb into row B; leave row C empty.
Add 1,000 µL of wash buffer to row D.
Add 1,000 µL of 80% ethanol to row E.
Add 100 µL of elution buffer into a separate elution strip tube.
Cover processing plates with paraffin film or MicroAmp Clear Adhesive Film to avoid evaporation.
Start the run and load the plate and elution strip tube when prompted.
After the run (~28 minutes), immediately transfer the eluate to a new tube or plate.

steps.title: Manual Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform nucleic acid extraction manually using a magnetic stand and shaker.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 μL of Proteinase K to each 1.5 mL sample tube.
Invert Binding Bead Mix to resuspend and add 520 µL to each sample.
Shake samples for 5 minutes at 900 rpm.
Briefly spin down and place tubes on a magnetic stand for at least 5 minutes until beads collect.
Carefully remove and discard supernatant without disturbing beads.
Remove from magnet and add 1 mL of Wash Buffer to each sample.
Close tubes and shake at 800 rpm for 30 seconds.
Place on magnetic stand for 3 minutes until beads collect; carefully remove and discard supernatant.
Repeat the wash process (shake 800 rpm for 30s, magnet 3 min, discard supernatant) using 1 mL of 80% ethanol.
Briefly centrifuge and remove residual solution with a fine-tipped pipette.
Air-dry beads by leaving the tube open for 2 minutes (do not overdry).
Add 100 μL of Elution Solution, vortex vigorously to resuspend, and shake at 800 rpm for 5 minutes.
Incubate at 75°C for 5 minutes.
Briefly centrifuge and place on magnetic stand for 3 minutes.
Carefully transfer eluates to a new clean 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: PCR Inhibitor Removal
steps.instruction: Remove inhibitors using the Zymo OneStep PCR Inhibitor Removal Kit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the column by loosening the screw cap and breaking off the bottom tip of the filter.
Insert the column into a Collection Tube and centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 3 minutes.
Add 100 µl of total nucleic acid extract to the Zymo-Spin IV-IR HRC filter and centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 3 minutes.
Transfer the prepared column to a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Storage and Analysis
steps.instruction: Store or use the filtered total nucleic acid.

substeps.instruction: Use the isolated nucleic acid immediately for PCR and downstream analysis, or store at −80 °C.
